ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $M$ is the midpoint of $BC$, $AN$ bisects $\angle BAC$, $BN\perp AN$ at point $N$, and $MN$ is connected. If $AB=10$, $BC=15$, and $MN=3$, what is the perimeter of $\triangle ABC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Extend $BN$ to meet $AC$ at point $D$,\\
$\because AN$ bisects $\angle BAC$, that is $\angle BAN = \angle DAN$,\\
$BN \perp AN$, that is $\angle BNA = \angle DNA = 90^\circ$, and $AN$ is the common side of $\triangle ABN$ and $\triangle ADN$\\
$\therefore \triangle ABN \cong \triangle ADN$, $AD = AB = 10$\\
$BN = DN$, that is, $N$ is the midpoint of $BD$\\
Also, $M$ is the midpoint of $BC$, $\therefore CD = 2MN = 6$\\
$\therefore$ The perimeter is: $AB + BC + CD + AD = 10 + 15 + 6 + 10 = \boxed{41}$

Also, $BN = DN$, so $N$ is the midpoint of $BD$. Since $M$ is the midpoint of $BC$, we get $CD = 2MN = 6$. Therefore, the perimeter is $AB + BC + CD + AD = 10 + 15 + 6 + 10 = 41$.
